name: apertus2-chonk-sft
title: Compare Chonk to other post-trained thinking models
description: Benchmarks for Apertus 2 Chonk SFT and the models it is compared with (Apertus 1.5 70B and 8B, Qwen3 32B), in table order. Mean@8 for AIME, mean@4 for the rest. MATH is not listed yet: its task (hendrycks_math or minerva_math) is undecided.

apertus-1.5-70b-thinking.description: swiss-ai/Apertus-v1.5-70B reasoning (--thinking with its <|inner_prefix|> / <|inner_suffix|> tokens). Window 32768.

apertus-1.5-8b-thinking.description: swiss-ai/Apertus-v1.5-8B reasoning (--thinking with its <|inner_prefix|> / <|inner_suffix|> tokens). Window 32768, as for the 70B.

qwen3-32b-thinking.description: Qwen/Qwen3-32B reasoning (--thinking with explicit <think> / </think> tokens). Window 32768, its native context.

apertus-2-chonk-sft.description: Apertus 2 Chonk SFT. No Jinja template exists: apertus-common renders the format, in lm_eval (--chat-format apertus2, completions endpoint, needs --backend openai and a verified tokenizer directory) and on the server for the other frameworks (vLLM plugin of apertus-common PR #5, see docs/thinking.md). The window 16384 is the checkpoint's name, not yet the maximal window.
